sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Continental Grafix USA is a manufacturer and supplier of wide-format graphic film solutions for windows, walls, and floors serving the commercial large format printing market since 2005.

Industry: Manufacturing · HQ: Statesville, North Carolina · Size: <$50M · Products: Perforated Window Films, Unperforated Window Films, Floor and Wall Films, panoRama Cast 1530C, panoRama Clear, panoRama Eclipse

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Continental Grafix USA scores 68 of 100 (tier B) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (24/30), application fit (25/25) and pain-point alignment (15/15). Nothing was found for event engagement, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on uv resistance, chemical resistance, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar PVF films hold colour and gloss through years of direct UV exposure. Tedlar resists solvents, cleaners and road chemicals without hazing. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (50% similar on films, graphic, window, protection); Mactac (46% similar on films, graphic, film, print); Drytac (46% similar on films, graphic, print, media). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.
